Third-party marks, verbatim. Never restyle, recolour or retype them.

- `base/` — the Base Square, Basemark and lockup. **White on dark; black or blue on light; never Base Blue on dark.** Use the lockup or Basemark with the copy "Built on Base."
- `self/` — Self.xyz logo, on-black (white + Self teal ink) and on-white versions. Only where Self verification is named.
